    LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.not_isRepresentationFinite_crown

    Band modules over the crown category #

    The crown category Cr m is the radical-square-zero category of the alternating cycle with sources x₀, …, xₘ, sinks z₀, …, zₘ and arrows ρᵢ : xᵢ → zᵢ, σᵢ : xᵢ₊₁ → zᵢ (indices mod m + 1). For λ ∈ kˣ the band module k^V (every arrow acts by 1, except σₘ by λ) is indecomposable, and band modules for different λ are not isomorphic. Hence k(Cr m) is representation-infinite over an infinite field (RayCat.not_isRepresentationFinite_crown).
